ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom data staging + MEGAsync/rclone cloud exfiltration chain
ucs.description: Detects INC Ransom's (GOLD IONIC) signature pre-encryption playbook: hands-on-keyboard archiving with 7-Zip/WinRAR into world-writable staging directories (C:\Users\Public, C:\PerfLogs, C:\Windows\Temp, C:\ProgramData) followed within ~30 minutes by network egress from MEGAsync.exe / MEGAcmdServer.exe / rclone.exe to MEGA cloud endpoints — the exact two-stage exfil pattern documented by SentinelLabs, Huntress and SOCRadar for INC double-extortion intrusions.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as archive_time values(Processes.process) as archive_cmd values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*a *","*-mx*","*-p*","*-v*") AND Processes.process IN ("*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\PerfLogs\\*","*\\Windows\\Temp\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\$Recycle.Bin\\*","*\\Temp\\*") by host Processes.process_name | rename host as dest, Processes.process_name as archive_bin | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as exfil_time values(All_Traffic.process_name) as exfil_bin values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as exfil_ip values(All_Traffic.dest) as exfil_host from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.process_name IN ("MEGAsync.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","rclone.exe","FileZilla.exe")) OR (All_Traffic.dest IN ("*.mega.nz","*.mega.co.nz","*.mega.io","*.userstorage.mega.co.nz")) by src | rename src as dest] | where exfil_time>=archive_time AND exfil_time<=archive_time+1800 | eval delay_min=round((exfil_time-archive_time)/60,1) | table archive_time exfil_time delay_min dest user archive_bin archive_cmd exfil_bin exfil_host exfil_ip | sort - archive_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let StagingPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\", @"\Temp\"]);
let ArchiveOps = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("a "," -mx"," -p"," -v"," -hp")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (StagingPaths)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ArchiveTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ArchiveBin=FileName, ArchiveCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("MEGAsync.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","MEGAclient.exe","rclone.exe","FileZilla.exe")
   or RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","userstorage.mega.co.nz")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| join kind=inner ArchiveOps on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (ArchiveTime .. ArchiveTime + WindowMin)
| project ArchiveTime, ExfilTime=Timestamp,
          DelayMin=datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ArchiveTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, ArchiveBin, ArchiveCmd,
          ExfilBin=InitiatingProcessFileName, ExfilCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by ArchiveTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let ArchiveOps = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe")
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("a "," -mx"," -p"," -v"," -hp")
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ArchiveTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ArchiveBin=ActingProcessName, ArchiveCmd=ActingProcessCommandLine;
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (DstHostname has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","userstorage.mega.co.nz"))
     or (Url has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io"))
| join kind=inner ArchiveOps on $left.DvcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (ArchiveTime .. ArchiveTime + WindowMin)
| project ArchiveTime, ExfilTime=TimeGenerated,
          DelayMin=datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ArchiveTime),
          DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ArchiveBin, ArchiveCmd,
          DstHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url
| order by ArchiveTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\7z.exe OR *\\7za.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\Rar.exe OR *\\7Z.exe OR *\\WINRAR.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Temp\\*) @CommandLine:(*" a "* OR *" -mx"* OR *" -p"* OR *" -hp"*)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@Image:(*\\MEGAsync.exe OR *\\MEGAcmdServer.exe OR *\\rclone.exe OR *\\megasync.exe OR *\\MEGASYNC.EXE) OR @DestinationHostname:(*.mega.nz OR *.mega.co.nz OR *.mega.io OR *.userstorage.mega.co.nz)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query: (#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(7z|7za|7zg|winrar|rar)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/\\(Users\\Public|PerfLogs|Windows\\Temp|ProgramData|\$Recycle\.Bin|Temp)\\/i CommandLine=/(\s+a\s+|\s+-mx|\s+-p|\s+-v\d|\s+-hp)/i) OR (#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(^|\.)(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|mega\.io|userstorage\.mega\.co\.nz)$/i) OR (#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 ContextImageFileName=/\\(megasync|megacmdserver|megaclient|rclone|filezilla)\.exe$/i) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, DomainName, ContextImageFileName, RemoteAddressIP4]) | min(@timestamp, as=first) | max(@timestamp, as=last) }) | eval window_min := (last-first)/60000 | window_min < 30
ucs.rationale: INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) is repeatedly documented (SentinelLabs, Huntress, ReliaQuest, Trustwave) deploying MEGAsync, MEGAcmd and rclone specifically to push 7-Zip/WinRAR-archived victim data to MEGA before launching the INC encryptor — this is a strong actor-specific signature distinct from generic ransomware (which more often uses raw HTTPS to attacker infrastructure). ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom hands-on-keyboard credential access: comsvcs.dll LSASS mini-dump + AdFind/netscan recon chain
ucs.description: Catches INC Ransom's documented post-access tradecraft on a freshly-compromised host: LSASS dumping via the rundll32 + comsvcs.dll MiniDump LOLBin trick (their preferred Mimikatz-alternative for evading AV signatures) co-occurring on the same host within 1 hour of AdFind.exe / netscan.exe / SoftPerfect NetScan domain reconnaissance — the classic GOLD IONIC pivot from initial access (Citrix CVE-2023-3519 / phishing) to lateral movement prep.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as recon_time values(Processes.process) as recon_cmd values(Processes.user) as recon_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AdFind.exe","netscan.exe","NetScan.exe","nltest.exe","PsLoggedon.exe") OR (Processes.process_name="nltest.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*/domain_trusts*","*/dclist*")) OR (Processes.process IN ("*-f \"(objectcategory=person)*","*-f objectcategory=computer*","*-sc trustdmp*","*trustdmp*"))) by host Processes.process_name | rename host as dest | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as dump_time values(Processes.process) as dump_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*" AND (Processes.process="*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*#24*") by host | rename host as dest] | where abs(dump_time-recon_time) < 3600 | eval delay_min=round((dump_time-recon_time)/60,1) | table recon_time dump_time delay_min dest recon_user recon_cmd dump_cmd | sort - recon_time
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 1h;
let Recon = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName in~ ("AdFind.exe","netscan.exe","NetScan.exe","nltest.exe","PsLoggedon.exe","SharpHound.exe"))
         or (FileName =~ "nltest.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/domain_trusts","/dclist","/dsgetdc"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("objectcategory=person","objectcategory=computer","trustdmp","-sc trustdmp","Domain Admins"))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ReconTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ReconBin=FileName, ReconCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let Dump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#24"," 24 ")
    | project DumpTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DumpCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              DumpParent=InitiatingProcessFileName, DumpParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
Recon
| join kind=inner Dump on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('second', DumpTime, ReconTime)) < toint(Window/1s)
| project ReconTime, DumpTime,
          DelayMin=datetime_diff('minute', DumpTime, ReconTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, ReconBin, ReconCmd, DumpCmd, DumpParent, DumpParentCmd
| order by ReconTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 1h;
let Recon = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName has_any ("\\AdFind.exe","\\netscan.exe","\\NetScan.exe","\\nltest.exe","\\PsLoggedon.exe","\\SharpHound.exe"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\nltest.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("/domain_trusts","/dclist","/dsgetdc"))
         or (CommandLine has_any ("objectcategory=person","objectcategory=computer","trustdmp","-sc trustdmp"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ReconTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ReconBin=NewProcessName, ReconCmd=CommandLine;
let Dump = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "comsvcs.dll"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#24"," 24 ")
    | project DumpTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, DumpCmd=CommandLine,
              DumpParent=ParentProcessName;
Recon
| join kind=inner Dump on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('second', DumpTime, ReconTime)) < toint(Window/1s)
| project ReconTime, DumpTime,
          DelayMin=datetime_diff('minute', DumpTime, ReconTime),
          Computer, SubjectUserName, ReconBin, ReconCmd, DumpCmd, DumpParent
| order by ReconTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: INC Ransom - rundll32 comsvcs.dll LSASS MiniDump
id: 5e1b4a2d-9c3f-4e7a-bf12-incransom-comsvcs
status: experimental
description: Detects the rundll32.exe + comsvcs.dll MiniDump LSASS dumping technique characteristically used by INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) operators in lieu of Mimikatz.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/inc-ransom/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.g1032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'comsvcs.dll'
  selection_func:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MiniDump'
      - '#24'
      - ' 24 '
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and selection_func
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate forensic / IR tooling — should be rare in production
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:(1 OR 4688)) @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\Rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll* OR *Comsvcs.dll* OR *COMSVCS.DLL*) @CommandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *minidump* OR *MINIDUMP* OR *"#24"* OR *" 24 "*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query: #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i CommandLine=/comsvcs\.dll/i CommandLine=/(minidump|#24|\s24\s)/i | join({ #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(adfind|netscan|nltest|psloggedon|sharphound)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(objectcategory=person|objectcategory=computer|trustdmp|\/domain_trusts|\/dclist)/i | groupBy([aid], function={ min(@timestamp, as=recon_time) }) }, field=aid, include=[recon_time]) | dump_time := @timestamp | delay_sec := abs(dump_time - recon_time)/1000 | delay_sec < 3600 | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([CommandLine, recon_time, dump_time, delay_sec]) })
ucs.rationale: INC Ransom intrusion reports from SentinelLabs, ReliaQuest and Trustwave SpiderLabs repeatedly call out three specific tools used in tight sequence on the first compromised host: AdFind for AD enumeration, SoftPerfect netscan for subnet sweeps, and the rundll32+comsvcs.dll MiniDump LOLBin for LSASS credentials. The comsvcs trick is a documented INC preference because it evades simple Mimikatz sign
